old522_routes.scope: Sampled centerline floor support and 0.48m-wide body-ray checks only, not a navmesh, full-area collision certification or a playable controller.
old522_routes.known_existing_paving_gaps: Original stone joints can be about 0.12m lower than stone tops; a future walking controller needs step tolerance or a separate collision proxy.

water.scope: Sampled finite background water surface only; no navigation or hydrodynamic claim.

physical_navigation.scope: 20cm new-circuit and SPACE05 courtyard sampling with 48cm body width and 2m height; 60cm grid of all newly authorized walkable areas plus four radius rays. Runtime height defines body base. Old decorative paving joints retain existing .17m support tolerance; new road/ramp tolerance .015m.

limitations: Read-only: no saving or rendering. Runtime navigation proxies are sampled against independent real Blender meshes, not a continuous physical proof.
Old source and versions are hash protected. Only explicit peripheral terrain, two curb crossings and gate-bar visibility changes are allowed in the new copy.
House interiors and landscape gardens remain non-walkable; developed streets are finite.
